human_oversight_policy.institutional_role: Academy Founder/Director, human facilitator, curriculum and rubric controller; MZB designation verification pending
human_oversight_policy.curriculum_publication: Owner-controlled authenticated versioning; preserve published source evidence and change history
human_oversight_policy.learner_evaluation: Fully automated source/rubric checks for routine lessons and research, with no admin grade override
human_oversight_policy.advanced_capstone: Independent second automated AI invocation; disagreement -> REWORK, no UC
human_oversight_policy.fallback: Unverifiable assessment remains PENDING/REWORK, preserving draft and idempotency
human_oversight_policy.operational_governance: Read-only quality dashboard, aggregate KPI metrics, source quality alerts, policy control and management review
human_oversight_policy.owner_personnel_model: Single human institutional oversight: Founder/Director; machine-evaluated learning and quality evidence. Auditor independence remains a separate future ISO audit duty.
